title: Linear Coding of LTI Sources Over Vector Gaussian Channels: A Majorization Approach
summary: We study the design of linear time-invariant (LTI) encoder-decoder pairs for transmitting the state of a discrete-time LTI vector source over power-constrained parallel Gaussian channels with feedback. Two types of power constraints are considered. Under individual subchannel power constraints, a necessary and sufficient condition for designing an encoder-decoder pair that achieves bounded estimation error covariance (EEC) is established via two coupled majorization inequalities involving the subchannel signal-to-noise ratios and the antistable poles of the source.
